WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(powerstatus, 'Missing') as powerstatus,
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM telescopes 
  GROUP BY powerstatus
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(count) as total_telescopes,
    COUNT(*) as num_statuses
  FROM status_counts
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    sc.powerstatus,
    sc.count,
    sc.count * 1.0 / t.total_telescopes as share,
    1.0 / t.num_statuses as avg_share
  FROM status_counts sc, totals t
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT 
    count,
    share
  FROM with_shares
  WHERE share > avg_share
)
SELECT 
  SUM(count) as total_telescopes_above_avg,
  AVG(share) as their_average_share,
  AVG(share) - (1.0/3) as how_far_above_average
FROM above_average
